Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance

Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1248
Claimant:
Charles Johnson
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
03/24/2024
Claim received for a low-speed collision in a parking lot involving the insured vehicle and a second vehicle. The
claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
05/03/2024
Reviewed the first notice of loss and the initial statements. The other driver confirms the accident happened as
described, and the scene photos are consistent with that account.
05/06/2024
Spoke with the claimant's attorney to confirm the injury claim is for a knee injury. The attorney has been asked to
provide the medical records and any prior treatment history for that area.
06/17/2024
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Two witness statements
also agree with the sequence of events as reported.
06/19/2024
Inspected the vehicle. The damage pattern matches the impact described by all parties, and no earlier damage to the
vehicle is known from prior records or the body shop history.
06/29/2024
Reviewed the claimant's statements from each contact so far. The account has stayed the same in every
conversation, with no change in the sequence of events or the position of the vehicles.
09/03/2024
Received the initial medical report. It is not yet clear whether the knee injury was caused by this crash, and the
treating provider has not yet linked the condition to the collision.
09/14/2024
Records from the claimant's prior care show a small strain in the same area sveeral years ago. That strain healed
fully, and the file notes it for comparison purposes only.
09/17/2024
Treatment has followed a usual course, with visits tapering as the patient improved. The billing and tretament dates
have been logged and are being reviewed against the recovrey timeline.
09/30/2024
Confirmed that nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage occurred before the coverage start date. The driver is
a household member of the policyholder and is covered as such under the policy.
10/20/2024
Causation for the knee injury remains open pending the full medical review. Next steps are to request the complete
treatment notes from the provider and to schedule a follow-up with the attorney's office.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
